This document lists Equipment Inspection Checklist I1, which must be performed 
from on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block. The first draft initiated 
by
Pyramid 220kv substation.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

CB must be isolated
completely and grounded on both sides,

Ensure that
the earthing switch must be connected on both sides of the CB.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Wear safety
helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses

Control Power
disconnected.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

1. 
Check the gas
density of each density monitors:
- An alarm contact giving an electrical signal in case of abnormal leakage. 
- Alarm level 1 gives signal and alarms level 2 locks out.

2. 
Clean the
insulators of the circuit breaker from salt and contaminants.

3. 
Lubricate the
bearing in the circuit breaker with grease on delivery and need normally not
lubricated other then at major overhauls.

4. 
Lubricate
plain bearings in parts of the mechanism such as arms links and link gears on
delivery. These bearings should be lubricated regularly with a few drops of
oil.

operate the circuit breaker a couple of times
